title: Murder Suspect Has a Stabbing Problem
description:
Police in Savannah, Georgia, confront a suspect accused of stabbing a U-Haul employee while allegedly attempting to steal a truck. Four years later, the same man, Delano Middleton, 48, now stands accused of stabbing 18-year-old J.T. Schroeder to death in a Walmart parking lot over the teen kicking his shopping cart. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
